props.name: label
props.description: The label for the tag group.

props.name: children
props.description: Function to render each tag or each tag's content.

props.name: size

props.description: Legacy visual variant. Prefer `isEmphasized` for S2 parity.

props.description: Whether selected tags use the emphasized accent fill.

props.description: Description text shown below the tag list.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message shown when invalid.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the group is invalid.

props.name: labelPosition

props.name: labelAlign
props.description: Text alignment for side labels.

props.name: groupActionLabel
props.description: Label for the optional group action button.

props.name: onGroupAction
props.description: Handler for the optional group action button.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Maximum visible rows. This is approximated with overflow clipping in Solid.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.
